lesson.title: Universal Narrative Reading
lesson.summary: Teach the reviewer to read narrative structure before any subject decision.
learningObjectives: Preserve ambiguity when the text does not settle the role.

concepts.title: Narrative framing
concepts.summary: How the scene is framed before classification.

reviewerQuestions.reasoningGuidance: Ask what kind of scene this is before looking for a violation.

examples: A dialogue exchange with visible speakers.
counterExamples: A forced legal conclusion without narrative support.

weak: A nearby cue that suggests speech.
insufficient: A guess about the speaker with no textual support.
confidenceGuidance: Lower confidence when the frame is ambiguous.

reportTemplates.reasonTemplate: The scene is framed as dialogue.
reportTemplates.recommendationTemplate: Read the speaker cues before classifying.
